faq.q: What is the main advantage of temporary email?
faq.a: The main advantage is enhanced privacy, as it prevents your permanent email from being exposed to spam and potential data breaches.

faq.q: Can I use a temporary email for social media accounts?
faq.a: Yes, but be cautious as some platforms may require permanent email for verification. Use temporary emails for less critical accounts.

faq.q: How long does a temporary email last?

faq.q: Is it legal to use temporary emails?
